title: add-benchmark-lab-multi-variant-profiling-and-reporting-pipeline-v133
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: We need consistent multi-variant profiling baselines and consolidated reporting for recent adaptive-batching experiments. This PR adds: 1) new representative workload runners that exercise multi-variant traffic patterns (latency, tail, cold-starts), 2) profiling baselines (memory, kernel-selection traces, and KV-cache hit matrices) for v133 runs, and 3) a reporting pipeline that folds profiling artifacts into BigQuery + Looker dashboards and ties metrics to the benchmark-lab job metadata. The change is backward compatible for existing runners; new config knobs are additive. Checklist: - [x] Add representative workload runners for multi-variant scenarios - [x] Add profiling baseline collector and serializer - [x] Add reporting pipeline ETL and BigQuery schema migration - [x] Add unit tests for new serializer and end-to-end smoke test for pipeline - [x] Update benchmark lab docs with runbook and annotation notes Notes: The description includes details about how variants are represented (variant_id + routing_weight) and how we canonicalize sequence-length histograms to reduce cardinality. See linked linear tasks for profiling experiment plan.
